paragraphs: An E. coli O26 outbreak linked to raw milk cheese has caused 13 cases and 8 hospitalizations across 9 states [1]. A Salmonella outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts has sickened 32 people with 3 hospitalizations across 6 states [2]. The CDC has declared an earlier Salmonella outbreak from backyard poultry flocks over, with 1,253 total infections [23].

Do not consume Sempio Korean Ginseng Chicken Stew Classic in 31.75-oz pouches distributed to FL, GA, IL, MD, NJ, NY, PA, and VA due to import violations [3]. Fontanini Pork Sausage Links (10-lb boxes, item 393, packed 06/23/2026) in CA, FL, MI, and NV are recalled for possible foreign matter contamination [4]. Everything Sprouts Crunchy Protein Sprout Mix (5.0 oz) distributed to MN and WI may contain STEC E. coli or Salmonella [5]. Taylor Fresh Foods Tomato Salsa Fresca (4 lbs, refrigerated) sold across 26 states may be contaminated with Salmonella [6]. NatureBest Pico de Gallo Hot in TX and LA is recalled due to potential Salmonella in jalapeños [7]. Markys Caviar Mon Sire Brie (1 kg, soft-ripened French cheese) in Florida may contain Listeria monocytogenes [8]. Foods Alive organic moringa leaf powder (8oz, UPC 8 91551 00092 8) sold nationwide has potential Salmonella contamination [9]. Frutas y Hortalizas Organic Triple Berry Blend (10 oz frozen) in Arkansas may contain E. coli O145:H28 [10].

Sierra Nevada Cheese Company is voluntarily recalling all Graziers Raw Milk Cheese due to potential E. coli O26:H11 contamination [16]. Mezzetta Golden Greek Peperoncini (32-oz, medium heat) is recalled for a dead mouse found in a jar [17]. Deano's Pear and Pecorino Triangoli Ravioli is recalled for undeclared lobster [18]. Galil Lior Cinnamon Ground Seasoning is recalled for elevated lead levels [19].
